meta.rom: Pokemon Recharged Yellow.gba (v1.9.7, pokeemerald rebuild, BPRE header cosmetic)
meta.extracted: 2026-08-18 by ROM scan; decode via research/structs.json charmap (Western table)

species_names.note: English; French table follows at index 412, German after; do not read past 412

items.layout: name[<=18] at +0 (0xFF-terminated), u16 price at +18, holdEffect +20, holdEffectParam +21, description ptr at +24, importance +28, unk +29, pocket +30, type +31, fieldUseFunc ptr +32, battleUsage u32 +36, battleUseFunc ptr +40, secondaryId u32 +44; no itemId column (vanilla Emerald's u16 itemId after name[14] is gone)
items.pocket_note: pocket byte at +30, SIX pockets (vanilla Emerald has 5): 1=Items, 2=Medicine (split out of Items), 3=Poke Balls, 4=TM/HM, 5=Berries, 6=Key Items (empirical: Potion/heals are 2, flutes/shards 1, all *Ball 3, TM/HM 4, *Berry 5, Bicycle 6). A 6-pocket bag means the SaveBlock1 bag layout differs from vanilla Emerald -- likely part of the +0x8C growth.

move_names.note: immediately after the 3-language species tables; another language table follows; a second ALL-CAPS English move table exists at 0x0877D5E8

mapsec_names.note: flat array of string pointers indexed by regionMapSectionId; 0x00-0x57 Hoenn (vanilla Emerald), 0x58+ Kanto/Sevii using FRLG mapsec numbering (0x58=Pallet Town exactly as FireRed); indices 66 and 87 have no name -- parser should fall back to 'MAPSEC_0x%02X' for unnamed sections

map_groups.map_header_layout: pokeemerald struct MapHeader: +0x12 u16 mapLayoutId, +0x14 u8 regionMapSectionId, +0x17 u8 mapType
map_groups.note: FRLG-style group organization: group 1=dungeons (first Viridian Forest), group 3=Kanto overworld (first Pallet Town), groups 4-14 town interiors, groups 29-40 Sevii, groups 41-43 retained Hoenn/Frontier maps
